enemies.name: Gingerbread Man
enemies.lore: Ran out of the North Pole ovens the moment the door opened and had been living off his own crumbs for months.

enemies.name: Snowman
enemies.lore: Came to life to a song once. Has been waiting for another one ever since.
lines: Imma stick you with my carrot!
I'll keep you frozen till New Year!

enemies.name: Bad Bauble
enemies.lore: Fell off the tree Last Christmas  and has held a grudge against holidays ever since.
lines: Tink tink! You'll break before I do!

enemies.name: Chimney Rat
enemies.lore: Despite their name, chimney rats prefer to live in arch-shaped holes cut into walls.

enemies.name: Tangled Lights
enemies.lore: Every string of lights that was ever stuffed in a box, tangled into one.

enemies.name: Wind-up Penguin
enemies.lore: A wind-up toy that kept going after its mechanism broke. It only knows forward.
lines: I only know how to move forward.

enemies.name: Nutcracker
enemies.lore: Cracks nuts for a living and wants everyone to know it.
lines: Nuts and grannies get cracked alike!

enemies.name: Tin Soldier
enemies.lore: Marches in perfect lines.

enemies.name: Jack-in-the-Box
enemies.lore: Has a habit of popping out at the worst possible moment. The reason is anxiety.
lines: Round and round the handle turns...

enemies.name: Fruity Snake
enemies.lore: Gifted and regifted forty times. All it ever wants is to be eaten.
lines: Feelin' thirsty? How about a PUNCH?

enemies.name: Broken Bauble
enemies.lore: A shapely fallen angel made out of fresh snow.

enemies.name: Eggnog Slime
enemies.lore: A spilled mug of eggnog that got ideas. Loves anything warm and cosy.

enemies.name: Icicle Bat
enemies.lore: Hangs in frozen caves. A good jingle echoes for days in there.
lines: I knew I should've stayed in Mt. Moon.

enemies.name: Grumpkin
enemies.lore: Hates the noise, the noise, the NOISE. Secretly loves a well-tied bow.
lines: You wouldn't like me when I'm grumpy.

enemies.name: Rogue Elf
enemies.lore: Quit the workshop over unpaid overtime. Always planning a getaway.
lines: Your cookies or your life! ...Actually, just the cookies.

enemies.name: Coal Golem
enemies.lore: Built from every lump of coal ever given. Craves a little spark.
lines: Every naughty child... made me BIGGER.

enemies.name: Candy Cane Viper
enemies.lore: A candy cane that grew fangs. A soft tune still charms it.
lines: Refresh yourssself with sssome peppermint venom!

enemies.name: Mistletoe Creeper
enemies.lore: Mistletoe that got tired of waiting for kisses.
lines: A kiss? How about a SQUEEZE.

enemies.name: Krampus Imp
enemies.lore: Krampus's little helpers. Pure mischief; nothing you give them is ever enough.
lines: The Master is coming! Heh heh!

enemies.name: Nutcracker General
enemies.lore: Commander of the Nutcracker army. Accepts only the finest tribute.
lines: You're just another nut to crush.

enemies.name: Abominable Snowman
enemies.lore: Lonely, enormous and very loud. A lullaby calms it right down.

enemies.name: Coal Baron
enemies.lore: Hoards coal and cookies alike. Values a gift by its price tag.
lines: Coal is the gift that keeps on giving.

enemies.name: Reindeer Alpha
enemies.lore: Led the sleigh team for a hundred Christmases. Still answers to the jingle of sleigh bells.
lines: The sleigh is broken. And so are the reins.
We pulled for HIM. Now we run wild!

enemies.name: Gingerbread Witch
enemies.lore: Lives in a gingerbread house. Will trade anything for a sprinkle of sparkle.

enemies.name: Jack Frost
enemies.lore: Nips noses for fun. Can't sit still; loves anything bouncy.

enemies.name: Corrupted Santa
enemies.lore: Read the whole Naughty List in one night. Somewhere under the coal, he's still Nick.
lines: What a ho-ho-horrible night to have a curse!

enemies.name: KRAMPUS
enemies.lore: What Santa becomes when the coal wins. There is no gift for this.
lines: SANTA IS GONE. KRAMPUS IS FOREVER!

enemies.name: The Naughty List
enemies.lore: The list itself, growing bigger with every naughty deed. Santa never had a chance.
lines: I CAN SEE INTO YOUR HEART.

events.title: The Lost Elf
events.text: A tiny elf shivers in a snowdrift, clutching a broken compass. "I may have taken a wrong turn at the candy cane forest..."

choices.label: Walk him home (lose 6 HP, gain a relic)

events.title: Abandoned Workshop
events.text: Half-finished toys line the dusty benches. The tools are still warm, as if the elves left in a hurry.

events.title: Carolers at the Door
events.text: A ragged group of carolers is singing in front of a house. They look like they've been at it for quite a long time. Their voices crack with cold.

events.title: The Frozen Pond
events.text: A frozen pond blocks the path. As you take a closer look, you note coins that twinkle under the ice. The ice creaks under your weight.

events.title: The Cookie Jar
events.text: On a windowsill, you notice an enormous cookie jar. A note reads: FOR SANTA ONLY.

choices.label: Reach in deep (+75 Cookies, gain Lump of Coal)

events.title: The Snow Globe Seller
events.text: An old woman sells snow globes. You take one from her hands almost absentmindedly.

events.title: The Empty Stable
events.text: Santa's reserve reindeer pace in their stalls, hungry and restless.

choices.label: Ride one (lose 10 HP, gain a relic)

events.title: The Wishing Well
events.text: You stop by a wishing well and look inside. You see countless coins far below.

choices.label: Toss a gift in (leave a gift)

events.title: Mischievous Elves
events.text: Two elves with red eyes block the path. "Hey, stranger! How about we play a game? Winner takes all!"

events.title: The Toy Factory
events.text: The conveyor belts at a toy factory still run. Toys roll by, waiting to be wrapped.

choices.label: Work overtime (lose 7 HP, choose a gift)
Take a nap on the sacks (heal 12)

events.title: The Gingerbread House
events.text: A cottage made entirely of gingerbread. You feel as though there's something or someone inside.

choices.label: Nibble the roof (heal 20, gain Lump of Coal)

events.title: Santa's Abandoned Sleigh
events.text: Santa's sleigh lies tipped in a ditch, one of its runners snapped. The seat is still warm.

events.title: The Naughty Child
events.text: A boy pelts you with snowballs. "Santa never came last year! Why in the hell should I be nice?"

choices.label: Give him a gift (leave; DOUBLE Spirit)

events.title: Mistletoe Arch
events.text: A great arch of mistletoe appears above the path.

choices.label: Cut a sprig (gain a random Uncommon gift)

events.title: The Old Toymaker
events.text: A stooped toymaker fixes a rocking horse by candlelight. "Need anything mended, dear?"

choices.label: Buy a toy (50 Cookies, choose a gift)

events.title: Blizzard!
events.text: A howling blizzard swallows the road. You can barely see the tip of your own nose.

choices.label: Drink a potion for warmth (lose a potion)

events.title: The Frozen Postman
events.text: A postman lies stuck in a snowdrift, his bag bursting with letters to Santa.

events.title: Hot Cocoa Stand
events.text: A cheerful elf runs a cocoa stand in the middle of nowhere. "Marshmallows are extra!"

events.title: Ice Fishing
events.text: A fishing hole and an abandoned rod. Something tugs at the line.

events.title: The Nutcracker's Ball
events.text: Music drifts from a ballroom where nutcrackers waltz to the tune. One of them bows to you.

events.title: Stocking on a Fence
events.text: A lonely stocking hangs on a fence post, bulging with something.

events.title: Snow Angels
events.text: A field of perfect, untouched snow sparkles under the moon.

events.title: The Fallen Star
events.text: A star has fallen into a snowbank, still glowing and sparking.

events.title: Secret Santa Swap
events.text: A masked stranger holds out a wrapped box. "Care for a swap, {title}? No peeking."

events.title: The Lonely Snowman
events.text: A small, friendly snowman sits alone in a park. It years for companionship.

choices.label: Build him a friend (-4 HP, +10 Spirit)
Take his scarf (gain Scarf Wrap+, -8 Spirit)

events.title: Mirror of Christmas Past
events.text: An ornate mirror shows you young, laughing beside an even younger Santa.

choices.label: Reach into the memory (duplicate a gift, -6 Max HP)

parts.name: Spring
parts.desc: Deal 4 damage to a random enemy.

parts.desc: Pops 1 Grumpy pip on any monster.
